info.title: PBL6 Home Renter API Components
info.description: Reusable OpenAPI components aligned with api-conventions.md. Component organization: schemas contains domain data models and the shared UUID scalar only; request DTOs are defined inline under requestBodies; response body DTOs, including error envelopes, public projections and pagination, are defined under the x-response-dtos extension; responses defines HTTP response descriptions, headers, media types and examples, referring to those DTOs with $ref. DTOs reference domain models where applicable and are not mixed into the model catalog. x-response-dtos is an OpenAPI extension, not a standard component category; importers may not display a separate DTO folder. This is a component library, not an endpoint specification: paths are intentionally empty. Resource schemas require role and ownership checks and are not automatically safe for public access. No CRUD endpoints are implied for internal joins, audit records or retained evidence. All JSON fields are required; nullable fields must be explicitly null. PATCH sends every editable field. JSON request objects reject undeclared properties. Each operation must declare access, ownership, lifecycle rules, allowed error codes, pagination strategy and filter/sort whitelist before P2-06 freeze.

servers.description: Local development only. Production must use an environment-specific HTTPS origin and /api/v1.

BearerAuth.description: 15-minute access token containing only sub (UUID), role (tenant/landlord/admin), iat and exp. Enforce role, action and ownership without role inheritance; preserve locked-tenant current-contract payment access.

RefreshCookie.name: refreshToken
RefreshCookie.description: Opaque rotating refresh token; fixed expiry 30 days after login. HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1/auth. Refresh accepts only this cookie, never JSON. Rotate on use without extending expiry. Reuse/expiry/revocation returns 401 and revokes the family. Logout revokes the session and clears the cookie.
